newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castorseed prices steady in narrow range.
newsitem.headline: Indian castorseed prices steady in narrow range.

text.p: Indian castorseed June delivery prices on Monday held steady in a narrow price band at 1,190/1,192 rupees per quintal amid restricted activity, floor sources said.
"Fresh overseas buying remained dull but limited new crop arrivals kept market around previous level," they said.
Daily arrivals of castorseed in the Gujarat region dropped to 30,000/35,000 bags (75 kg each) against earlier average of 40,000/50,000 bags.
Groundnut oil slid by 2/3 rupees to 340/341 rupees per 10 kg on unloading by the stockist as Friday's budget kept import duty on edible oils unchanged at 20 percent.
"Prior to the budget, traders were expecting duty to go up by 10 percent which did not happen," one miller said.
"In this backdrop even imported palm oil has fallen today by a rupee at 280/281 rupees per 10 kg," he said.
In Rajkot spot groundnut oil was steady at 515 rupees per 15 kg.
